topics.question: The code the AI gave you doesn't work. What's the best next step?
options: Paste the exact error message and ask it to explain and fix it.
topics.explanation: AI fixes code best when it sees the real error. Reading errors is something we practise in class.

topics.question: Which goal is easier to measure?
options: 50 sign-ups from Instagram ads within 30 days.
topics.explanation: Specific, measurable goals with a deadline show exactly what is working.

topics.question: Which prompt gives the AI what it needs for an SEO article?
options: Write an 800-word article for the keyword “running shoes”, with 3 subheadings and a meta description under 155 characters.
topics.explanation: Specific prompts, with keyword, structure and length, give the AI the right context.

topics.question: An AI tool gives you a statistic for a client report. What do you do?
options: Put it straight into the report.
Check it against a trusted source first.
topics.explanation: AI can sound confident and still be wrong. Verify facts before you share them.

faq.title: The questions we get asked most

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: You pay month by month: €89 a month instead of €150. Choose card (Stripe, confirmed instantly) or bank transfer (the seat is held for 48 hours until we confirm the payment). You pay the next month from your panel.

items.question: How do refunds work?
items.answer: [PUT THE REFUND POLICY HERE: within how many days, in which cases and how to ask.]

items.question: What if I miss a lecture?
items.answer: It happens. The materials of every lecture and the offline lessons are in your panel, and you can ask the instructor about anything unclear. Attendance is recorded, so try to follow as many live lectures as you can.

items.question: How many people are in a group?
items.answer: At most 10. When a group fills up you can join the waitlist and get a seat in the next group.

items.question: When are the lectures?
items.answer: Three times a week for 2 hours, live on Google Meet, usually in the evening so you can follow after work. You see the exact schedule of the group before you register and get it by email as soon as your seat is confirmed.

items.question: What do I need to follow the course?
items.answer: A computer or laptop with a stable internet connection, a camera and a microphone. Google Meet opens right in the browser. For the coding course a computer is a must.

items.question: How do the tests work?
items.answer: The test opens in the last week of each month and is taken online. It lasts about 45 minutes, with single- and multiple-choice and true/false questions. You pass with 70% or more and have two attempts.

items.question: What language are the courses in?
items.answer: Albanian. Some tools and terms are in English, but everything is explained in Albanian, step by step.
